title: Formal-conjectures resolution rate
summary: 159 open problems in formal-conjectures moved to solved in September 2026, against 41 in the three months before.
plot_title: Open problems retagged solved in formal-conjectures, by window, to upstream 137aec5c
discussion: Counts follow each theorem name from an open tag at the window start to its tag at the window end. September moved 159 of 1,396 tracked open problems, 11.4%, across about 117 commits by about 24 authors, and 88 carry a formal-proof link. The earlier windows moved 5, 10, 39 and 41. A retag covers new proofs, counterexamples and corrected tags, and this count read no proof. The last window is one month; the others are three.
